versions.changelog: v1.0.1: Move 'why .mjs' explanation from SKILL.md to references/why-mjs.md (developer-facing). SKILL.md 837 → 726 words. No code changes.

Initial release. 3 profile modes (shared/per-agent/ephemeral), subagent inheritance with default-inherit/independent flag, auto-discovery from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json agents.list at runtime, cross-process attach via /tmp/agent-browser-registry.json, dynamic Chrome path detection (linux + macOS). All operations local-only; no data forwarded to third parties.
